about.title: About Password Generator
about.desc: DopaBrain Password Generator creates strong, random passwords using the Web Crypto API directly in your browser. Customize length, character types, and complexity. Features a real-time strength meter, one-click copy, and password history. No sign-up, no server storage, completely free.
about.howTitle: How to Generate a Secure Password
about.howDesc: Set your desired password length (8-64 characters), select which character types to include, and click Generate. The strength meter shows your password security level. Click Copy to save it to your clipboard instantly.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Yes. Passwords are generated entirely in your browser using the Web Crypto API. No data is sent to any server, ensuring complete privacy and security.
faq.q2: How long should my password be?
faq.a2: We recommend at least 12 characters for general use and 16+ characters for sensitive accounts like banking or email.
faq.q3: Can I customize which characters are included?
faq.a3: Yes. You can toggle uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and special characters independently to meet any password requirements.
faq.a4: Generated passwords are only saved in your browser's local history for convenience. They never leave your device and are not stored on any server.
faq.a5: A strong password is long (12+ characters), uses a mix of uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and special characters, and is unique for each account.
